invariants.description: u = u_0 + q_C/(C/2) + u_ext + 2 R_v (inflow - v) and u_d = u_0 + q_C_d/(C/2) + u_ext + 2 R_v (v - outflow)
invariants.expr: np.max(np.abs((np.concatenate((u, u_d))) - (np.concatenate((u_0 + q_C/(C/2) + u_ext + 2*(0.01/(C))*(v_in - v), u_0 + q_C_d/(C/2) + u_ext + 2*(0.01/(C))*(v - (v_out))))))) <= 1e-08*(np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate((u, u_d)))) + np.max(np.abs(np.concatenate((u_0 + q_C/(C/2) + u_ext + 2*(0.01/(C))*(v_in - v), u_0 + q_C_d/(C/2) + u_ext + 2*(0.01/(C))*(v - (v_out))))))) + 1e-30

invariants.description: exact volume balance with both flows imposed: q(t) = q(0) + ((v_in) - (v_out)) t
steady state at t_end: v = (v_in + v_out)/2 (the two half compliances fill at the same rate)

bc_sweep.rationale: Boundary conditions span physiological operating values for the vessel class (arterial inlet 60-150 mmHg, venous 0-15 mmHg, flows 0-2x the nominal flow; +-0.5% for the nonlinear vv types, whose volume drifts by (v_in - v_out) t and collapses the tube if the imbalance is larger); constants are swept 0.5-2x their value; rho and mu are swept 0.5-2x their library (test_fft fixture) value of 1; beta_g 0-1; g 1-9.81; the wall-thickness constants a-d between the fixture value 1 and the proposed Blanco 2015 values. The physiological rho/mu (1050, 0.004) cannot yet be combined with the others at the run point (framework issue), so the swept regime is the library one. Excluded: tube-law exponents (they define the law), switches (R_flag, blood_ctl_dir).

baseline.reason: a single vessel under constant boundary conditions has no measured counterpart; validation needs a network assembled from these modules. Candidate: venous pressure/flow waveforms of the Muller & Toro (2014) global model or measured central venous pressure ranges (proposal only, not set up).
